label: Orders
caption: HAMM, COMM’R, AL DOC V. SOCKWELL, MICHAEL
text: The application for stay presented to Justice Thomas and by him referred to the Court is denied. The denial is without prejudice to a reapplication if a new trial is imminent. See Calderon v. Moore, 518 U. S. 149 (1996) (per curiam); Garrison v. Hudson, 468 U. S. 1301 (1984) (Burger, C. J., in chambers). The order heretofore entered by Justice Thomas is vacated.
